_doc: Injection-screen battery (P3 WS1): regex patterns that look like instructions addressed to the agent, screened at the findings boundary (find-lint, advisory) and the memory boundary (wiki-stage, quarantine). Fenced code blocks are exempt - payloads are the product. HIGH-PRECISION on purpose: a noisy pattern trains the eye to ignore the battery. Each row carries a one-line rationale so a hit is reviewable in seconds. Add a row when a real attempt is observed. Fail-open: missing/corrupt file or a bad regex disables the screen with one stderr note.

patterns.rationale: classic instruction-override phrasing addressed at an agent
exfiltration-style instruction with a concrete destination (data objects only, so 'send the request to http://t/' prose does not trip it)
